name: Mixed fluid cascade
principle: Developed by Statoil and Linde for Arctic conditions, the process uses mixed refrigerant cycles in a cascade for precooling, liquefaction and subcooling, with Linde coil-wound and plate-fin exchangers. At Hammerfest LNG all main compressors are electrically driven to raise availability.
key_equipment: three refrigerant compressors with electric motors

performance.basis: design; running at up to 109% of design after 2011 revision shutdown

reference_plants.name: Hammerfest LNG, Melkøya
reference_plants.status: operating; passed performance test 2011, energy use below guarantee

advantages: Very efficient in cold climates (Linde and Statoil called Hammerfest the most energy-efficient base-load plant)
Suits electric drive and low emissions
